label: Spells, draws and discards: instants and sorceries, card draw, cost changes, tutors, lands

cards.name: Sylvan Library
gaps: At the beginning of your draw step, you may draw two additional cards.
If you do, choose two cards in your hand drawn this turn.
For each of those cards, pay 4 life or put the card on top of your library.

cards.name: Temur Ascendancy
gaps: Whenever a creature you control with power 4 or greater enters, you may draw a card.

cards.name: Eidolon of Blossoms
gaps: Constellation — Whenever this creature or another enchantment you control enters, draw a card.

cards.name: Padeem, Consul of Innovation
gaps: At the beginning of your upkeep, if you control the artifact with the greatest mana value or tied for the greatest mana value, draw a card.

cards.name: High Tide
gaps: Until end of turn, whenever a player taps an Island for mana, that player adds an additional {U}.

cards.name: Arbor Elf
gaps: {T}: Untap target Forest.

cards.name: Expressive Iteration
gaps: Look at the top three cards of your library.
Put one of them into your hand, put one of them on the bottom of your library, and exile one of them.
You may play the exiled card this turn.

cards.name: Tear Asunder
gaps: Kicker {1}{B} (You may pay an additional {1}{B} as you cast this spell.)
If this spell was kicked, exile target nonland permanent instead.

cards.name: Dramatic Reversal
gaps: Untap all nonland permanents you control.

cards.name: Chord of Calling
gaps: Search your library for a creature card with mana value X or less, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle.

cards.name: Ashaya, Soul of the Wild
gaps: Nontoken creatures you control are Forest lands in addition to their other types. (They're still affected by summoning sickness.)

cards.name: Cyberdrive Awakener
gaps: When this creature enters, each noncreature artifact you control becomes a 4/4 artifact creature until end of turn.

cards.name: Soul's Attendant
gaps: Whenever another creature enters, you may gain 1 life.

cards.name: Archmage of Runes
gaps: Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, draw a card.

cards.name: Bloodletter of Aclazotz
gaps: If an opponent would lose life during your turn, they lose twice that much life instead. (Damage causes loss of life.)

cards.name: Meteor Golem
gaps: When this creature enters, destroy target nonland permanent an opponent controls.

cards.name: Avacyn, Angel of Hope
gaps: Other permanents you control have indestructible.

cards.name: Kenrith's Transformation
gaps: Enchanted creature loses all abilities and is a green Elk creature with base power and toughness 3/3. (It loses all other card types and creature types.)

cards.name: Jhoira, Weatherlight Captain
gaps: Whenever you cast a historic spell, draw a card. (Artifacts, legendaries, and Sagas are historic.)

cards.name: The Wind Crystal
gaps: {4}{W}{W}, {T}: Creatures you control gain flying and lifelink until end of turn.

cards.name: Throne of Eldraine
gaps: As Throne of Eldraine enters, choose a color.
Spend this mana only to cast monocolored spells of that color.
{3}, {T}: Draw two cards.
Spend only mana of the chosen color to activate this ability.

cards.name: Hour of Reckoning
gaps: Destroy all nontoken creatures.

cards.name: Fiery Inscription
gaps: When this enchantment enters, the Ring tempts you.

cards.name: Tragic Slip
gaps: Morbid — That creature gets -13/-13 until end of turn instead if a creature died this turn.

cards.name: Chimil, the Inner Sun
gaps: At the beginning of your end step, discover 5. (Exile cards from the top of your library until you exile a nonland card with mana value 5 or less. Cast it without paying its mana cost or put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom in a random order.)

cards.name: Organic Extinction
gaps: Improvise (Your artifacts can help cast this spell. Each artifact you tap after you're done activating mana abilities pays for {1}.)
Destroy all nonartifact creatures.

cards.name: City on Fire
gaps: If a source you control would deal damage to a permanent or player, it deals triple that damage instead.

cards.name: Aura Shards
gaps: Whenever a creature you control enters, you may destroy target artifact or enchantment.

cards.name: Marvin, Murderous Mimic
gaps: Marvin has all activated abilities of creatures you control that don't have the same name as this creature.

cards.name: Isochron Scepter
gaps: Imprint — When this artifact enters, you may exile an instant card with mana value 2 or less from your hand.
{2}, {T}: You may copy the exiled card.
If you do, you may cast the copy without paying its mana cost.

cards.name: Cut a Deal
gaps: Each opponent draws a card, then you draw a card for each opponent who drew a card this way.

cards.name: Apex Devastator
gaps: Cascade
cascade
cascade

cascade (When you cast this spell, exile cards from the top of your library until you exile a nonland card that costs less. You may cast it without paying its mana cost. Put the exiled cards on the bottom in a random order. Multiple instances of cascade each trigger separately.)

cards.name: Syphon Mind
gaps: Each other player discards a card.
You draw a card for each card discarded this way.

cards.name: Borne Upon a Wind
gaps: You may cast spells this turn as though they had flash.

cards.name: Angel of the Ruins
gaps: When this creature enters, exile up to two target artifacts and/or enchantments.

cards.name: Wheel of Fortune
gaps: Each player discards their hand, then draws seven cards.

cards.name: Inspiring Statuary
gaps: Nonartifact spells you cast have improvise. (Your artifacts can help cast those spells. Each artifact you tap after you're done activating mana abilities pays for {1}.)

cards.name: Crackle with Power
gaps: Crackle with Power deals five times X damage to each of up to X targets.

cards.name: Collective Resistance
gaps: Escalate {G} (Pay this cost for each mode chosen beyond the first.)
Choose one or more —
• Destroy target artifact.
• Destroy target enchantment.
• Target creature gains hexproof and indestructible until end of turn.
